description: For an existing wallet with a working signer or transaction tool, begin headless merchant enrollment. Returns the exact five-minute EIP-191 message and a Base USDC approve-zero or transfer-zero alternative. Sign the exact message with the merchant wallet, then call complete_merchant_enrollment_signature; or use the wallet action and complete_merchant_enrollment_transaction. 402Mob never receives a private key. Store the returned merchant API key securely.
name: create_merchant_enrollment_challenge
